files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.AggregateRoot
files.Summary: Base class for aggregate roots with built‑in domain event collection.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IAggregateRoot
files.Summary: Marks an entity as an aggregate root that can collect domain events.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IChaparBus
files.Summary: Primary abstraction for sending events and commands onto the message bus.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IChaparDbContext
files.Summary: Marker interface for the DbContext used by Chapar stores. Implement this interface on your application's DbContext to resolve ambiguous injections when multiple DbContext types are registered in the DI container.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IChaparRequestClient<TRequest, TResponse>
files.Summary: Abstraction for request/response messaging pattern. The client is specialised for one request‑response pair and is typically registered in the DI container for a specific TRequest.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.ICommand
files.Summary: Represents a command that is sent to exactly one logical receiver. Commands express an intent that should be executed once.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IConsumeFilter
files.Summary: An abstraction for a filter that is applied to every incoming message before it reaches the handler. Implementations can enforce policies like Idempotency (Inbox pattern), validation, etc.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IDomainEvent
files.Summary: Marker interface for domain events that are handled internally within the domain.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IEvent
files.Summary: Represents an event that can be broadcast to any number of subscribers. Events are immutable facts that happened in the past.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IIntegrationEvent
files.Summary: Marker interface for events that cross service boundaries and are published on the message bus (Integration Events).

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IMessage
files.Summary: Marker interface for all messages flowing through the Chapar bus. There is no constraint on the structure; it exists to enable compile‑time dispatch.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IMessageContext
files.Summary: Represents the full context of a message that is currently being processed by the bus.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IMessageContextAccessor
files.Summary: Provides access to the current .

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Abstractions.IMessageHandler<TMessage>
files.Summary: Defines a handler for a specific message type. The bus infrastructure will invoke this when a matching message arrives.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Attributes.AllowedOriginAttribute
files.Summary: Specifies the expected origin service for a message handler. When applied, the OriginValidationBehaviour in the pipeline checks that the incoming message contains an "Origin" header with this value.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Attributes.ExchangeAttribute
files.Summary: Specifies that a message should be published to a specific exchange, or that a handler should consume from a specific exchange. Can be applied multiple times for complex routing topologies.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Attributes.ExchangeType
files.Summary: Represents the type of an exchange in RabbitMQ.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Attributes.QueueNameAttribute
files.Summary: Specifies the queue name that a consumer should bind to when processing commands. If not provided, MassTransit's default naming convention is used.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Cleanup.CleanupOptions
files.Summary: Configuration for the cleanup background service.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Cleanup.ICleanupStore
files.Summary: A store that supports deleting old processed records.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Exceptions.IDomainException
files.Summary: Marker interface for domain-level exceptions that should not be retried.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Exceptions.OriginValidationException
files.Summary: The exception that is thrown when the origin of an incoming message does not match the expected value defined by . Implements so that the pipeline does not trigger retries.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Inbox.IInboxStore
files.Summary: Abstraction for storing and tracking incoming message ids to guarantee exactly‑once processing.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Inbox.InboxMessage
files.Summary: Represents a record of an incoming message that has been (or is being) processed. Used by the Inbox pattern to guarantee exactly‑once processing semantics.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Messages.ParcelMessage
files.Summary: A Chapar event that carriers the parcel data from Third party's outbox.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Metrics.IInboxMetrics
files.Summary: Defines core counter metrics for inbox message processing.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Metrics.IOutboxMetrics
files.Summary: Defines core counter metrics for outbox message processing.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Outbox.IOutboxStore
files.Summary: Contract for persisting outgoing messages before they are sent to the broker. Each provider (e.g. MassTransit, Zamin) will supply its own implementation.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Outbox.OutboxMessage
files.Summary: Represents a message that has been stored locally as part of an outbox and is waiting to be dispatched to the real message broker.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Pipeline.IPipelineBehavior<TMessage>
files.Summary: Defines a behaviour that can be plugged into the message handling pipeline. Behaviours are executed in a chain around the core handler logic.

files.Title: Chapar.Core.Utilities.HeaderSanitizer
files.Summary: Provides a helper to remove sensitive or dangerous data from message headers. This is particularly useful before logging or persisting headers.

files.Title: Chapar.Inbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Extensions.ChaparInboxExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for configuring the Chapar Inbox on Entity Framework Core.

files.Title: Chapar.Inbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Options.ChaparInboxOptions
files.Summary: Configuration options for the Chapar Inbox pattern.

files.Title: Chapar.Inbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Stores.EfInboxStore
files.Summary: Entity Framework Core implementation of and . Relies on a unique database constraint on (MessageId, ConsumerTypeName) to provide atomic reservations, and supports both at‑most‑once and at‑least‑once delivery via .

files.Title: Chapar.Inbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Stores.InboxMessageEntity
files.Summary: Entity that maps to the inbox table.

files.Title: Chapar.MassTransit.Consumers.ChaparConsumerAdapter<T>
files.Summary: Bridges the generic to MassTransit's , and applies the Inbox pattern for idempotent processing.

files.Title: Chapar.MassTransit.Extensions.ChaparMassTransitExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for to register Chapar services backed by MassTransit and RabbitMQ.

files.Title: Chapar.MassTransit.Extensions.ChaparMassTransitHealthCheckExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for adding Chapar health checks.

files.Title: Chapar.MassTransit.Filters.ChaparConsumeFilter<T>
files.Summary: Populates the ambient for the current consumed message.

files.Title: Chapar.MassTransit.Options.ChaparMassTransitOptions
files.Summary: Configuration options for the MassTransit‑based Chapar bus.

files.Title: Chapar.MassTransit.Options.ExchangeConfig
files.Summary: Configuration for a default exchange binding.

files.Title: Chapar.MassTransit.Options.ResilienceOptions
files.Summary: Retry and circuit breaker settings for the Chapar MassTransit transport. These are applied automatically when using AddChaparMassTransit.

files.Title: Chapar.Outbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Extensions.ChaparOutboxExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for configuring the Chapar Outbox on Entity Framework Core.

files.Title: Chapar.Outbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Interceptors.OutboxInterceptor
files.Summary: An EF Core that, before saving changes, extracts domain events from aggregate roots and persists the configured subset as records.

files.Title: Chapar.Outbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Options.ChaparOutboxOptions
files.Summary: Options for controlling which types of domain events are persisted to the outbox by the .

files.Title: Chapar.Outbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Stores.EfOutboxStore
files.Summary: Entity Framework Core implementation of and .

files.Title: Chapar.Outbox.EntityFrameworkCore.Stores.OutboxMessageEntity
files.Summary: Entity that maps to the outbox table.

files.Title: Chapar.Pipeline.Behaviours.DiagnosticsBehaviour<TMessage>
files.Summary: Logs the start, successful completion, and elapsed time of each message handler, and also creates a distributed tracing Activity with message details.

files.Title: Chapar.Pipeline.Behaviours.DomainExceptionHandlingBehaviour<TMessage>
files.Summary: Catches and logs them as warnings, preventing them from triggering MassTransit's retry policies.

files.Title: Chapar.Pipeline.Behaviours.ErrorHandlingBehaviour<TMessage>
files.Summary: A generic error handling behaviour that logs any unhandled exceptions before rethrowing them.

files.Title: Chapar.Pipeline.Behaviours.OriginValidationBehaviour<TMessage>
files.Summary: Validates the origin of an incoming message by checking a configurable header against the applied on the message type. This behavior is automatically registered when AddChaparPipeline is called.

files.Title: Chapar.Zamin.Consumer.ChaparMessageConsumer
files.Summary: Consumes events published by the outbox, deserializes the inner domain event, and dispatches it using Zamin's . Inbox idempotency is enforced via .

files.Title: Chapar.Zamin.Outbox.Extensions.ChaparZaminOutboxExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for configuring Chapar Outbox and Inbox on Zamin infrastructure.

files.Title: Chapar.Zamin.Outbox.Inbox.ZaminInboxStore
files.Summary: Implements using Zamin's native table and .

files.Title: Chapar.Zamin.Outbox.Outbox.ZaminOutboxStore
files.Summary: Implements and using Zamin's native OutBoxEventItem table.

files.Title: Chapar.Zamin.SendMessageBus.ZaminChaparSendMessageBus
files.Summary: Implements by delegating to the Chapar bus. Outbox records (Parcel) are published as events.
